strategy.offer: High-precision optical sensors, instruments, subsystems, and test equipment for satellite attitude control, rendezvous and docking, and Earth observation.
strategy.customers: Space agencies, satellite manufacturers, and commercial and institutional space programs worldwide.
strategy.why_we_win: Space missions demand extreme precision and robustness; the firm relies on proven products, quality, reliability, and trusted long-term customer relationships.
strategy.resources: Decades of optoelectronic engineering experience, skilled and motivated employees, strong technological capabilities, certified quality processes, and research and industry collaborations.
strategy.direction: Advance sensor and optical technologies for future space missions while expanding Earth-observation capabilities that provide useful data on our planet.
